access.read: Admin or the developer / team member who owns the project
access.delete: Admin or the developer / team member who owns the project

fields.name: developer
fields.label: Builder
fields.description: Auto-filled from the listing — the builder this event rolls up to.

fields.name: session_id
fields.label: Session ID
fields.description: Anonymous per-browser-session id (localStorage) — same one the internal view/session tracking already uses. Used to detect repeat actions.

fields.name: user
fields.label: User
fields.description: The signed-in Payload user, if any — most visitors won't have one.

fields.name: is_duplicate
fields.label: Duplicate
fields.description: Auto-flagged: same session + listing + event type seen again within 30 minutes. Excluded from rollup counters, kept for raw traffic visibility.

fields.name: is_bot
fields.label: Bot
fields.description: Auto-flagged from the User-Agent (crawlers, headless browsers, missing UA). Excluded from rollup counters.

fields.name: traffic_source
fields.label: Traffic Source
fields.description: organic_search / organic_social / paid_search / paid_social / referral / direct.

fields.name: source_page
fields.label: Source Page
fields.description: Which page the event happened on, e.g. colombo, sitewide
